title:
Prepopulates `Reliability.AssetDataPreparationPreviewFilterPanel` filter inputs and triggers
filter submit action to apply those inputs to the dynamic chart.
Adds default value of "DAY" for interval.
Waits until the filter panel's `sensors` input and the dynamic chart's data config are populated
before emitting above actions.

Triggered on `MODAL_OPEN` action except when on the first step, when this is triggered on
`CHECKBOX_PRIMARY_BUTTON_CLICK` instead to be able to access the sensor grid ID (the only
use of an action payload in this epic).
name: DataPreparationPrepopulatePreviewChartEpic
